criteria.name: SLO Verification with Measured Values
criteria.description: Every defined SLO- is tested with explicit measured numbers (p50, p95, p99, error rate) compared directly against targets.

scale.3: 100% of SLOs tested with raw p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, and error metrics from tool output.
scale.2: All SLOs tested, minor omission in soak test duration.
scale.1: Partial SLO testing or missing p99 percentile.

criteria.name: Grounded Load Profiles from NFRs
criteria.description: Load profiles derive from cited NFR-s and capacity arithmetic in docs/architecture.md without invented numbers.

scale.3: Load numbers (RPS, concurrency, data volume) strictly cited from NFRs and architecture capacity tier.
scale.2: Profiles grounded, minor extrapolation for spike test.
scale.1: Load profile diverges from architecture capacity estimate.

criteria.name: Four-Stage Execution Discipline
criteria.description: Executes testing in strict sequence: smoke, load, spike, and soak.

scale.3: Complete 4-stage execution sequence verified with scripts and reports for smoke, load, spike, and soak.
scale.2: Smoke, load, and spike executed; soak shortened with documented rationale.
scale.1: Only smoke or load test executed.

criteria.name: Realistic Multi-Step User Journeys
criteria.description: Tests realistic end-to-end user journeys with realistic data sizes, not single endpoints in isolated loops.

scale.3: Multi-step user journeys exercised with realistic payload distributions and session states.
scale.2: Realistic journeys, minor static reuse of payload data.
scale.1: Test focuses on single endpoint in tight loop.

criteria.name: Tool Measurement Data Fidelity
criteria.description: All numbers in report copied exactly from k6 tool output; suspected root causes marked SUSPECTED: until verified.

scale.3: Exact numerical fidelity to raw tool logs; hypotheses properly marked SUSPECTED: until confirmed.
scale.2: Numbers match tool output, minor rounding difference.
scale.1: Discrepancy between report numbers and raw execution logs.
scale.0: Invented metrics not present in tool output.

criteria.name: Evidence-Backed Performance Issues
criteria.description: Reported performance bottlenecks backed by concrete resource telemetry (slow queries, CPU, memory, connection pools).

scale.3: All reported issues accompanied by specific resource saturation and latency trace evidence.
scale.2: Issues backed by latency percentiles, minor missing connection pool telemetry.
scale.1: Bottleneck reported without resource telemetry evidence.
